verdict.rationale: The evidence implies a pre-production environment separate from production, though none describes it explicitly. The MCP account tools can 'set up production instances' (clerk-docs-56), the CLI 'ship[s] your auth to production' (clerk-docs-40), and agents can provision throwaway accountless apps and keys (clerk-docs-67). Webhooks can also be relayed to a local handler for testing (clerk-docs-38). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a development/sandbox instance with isolated data, test credentials or test users, any statement that sandbox data cannot reach production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
